gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histologically confirmed high-grade glioma, with standard radiotherapy and chemotherapy post-surgical resection deemed unsuccessful, and recurrence confirmed by imaging.

candidate_evidence.quote: this study aims to observe the safety and efficacy of SMES combined with ABX in treating patients with recurrent high-grade gliomas postoperatively

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Histologically confirmed high-grade glioma, with standard radiotherapy and chemotherapy post-surgical resection deemed unsuccessful, and recurrence confirmed by imaging.

role_evidence.quote: Specific Model Electroacupuncture Stimulation Promotes Paclitaxel Delivery Across the BBB for Postoperative Glioma Patients: A Randomized Controlled Study
Temozolomide（TMZ） was given orally or intravenously 150mg/(m2·d) for 5 days, repeated every 28 days for 6 cycles

coder_notes: Recurrent high-grade glioma; glioblastoma not named in conditions, title, inclusion or arm labels, so high_grade_glioma_unspecified (excluded as not_glioblastoma). Nab-paclitaxel delivery across BBB enabled by electroacupuncture device (SMES), hence device_dependent. Albumin-bound paclitaxel is an existing marketed formulation; formulation_flag left none (could be new_formulation relative to paclitaxel). TMZ given in both arms (backbone); the OTHER-type TMZ group functions as control. Tumour-tissue paclitaxel levels mentioned only as preliminary research, not a planned measurement.
